claim: All AWS SDKs work with 20-second long polls by default. If you don't use an AWS SDK, or if you configured your SDK to have a shorter timeout, you might need to modify your SQS client to allow longer requests or to use a shorter long-poll timeout.

qualifiers.scope: SQS clients (AWS SDKs and other clients)

evidence.quote: All AWS SDKs work with 20-second long polls by default. If you don't use an AWS SDK to access Amazon SQS, or if you configured your AWS SDK to specifically have a shorter timeout, you might need to modify your Amazon SQS client to allow longer requests or to use a shorter long-poll timeout.
